name: Bran
subtitle: The Blessed
description: Sacrifice your health for the survival of your Allies providing Shields and Restoring their Life.
lore: A giant of immense physical might and necromantic magics, Bran the Blessed fought multiple wars waged over the hurt feelings of others. Now he is hesitant to act on the urgings of anyone else, relying solely on his own judgment. While this prevents unnecessary bloodshed, it also makes him slow to rise in Avalon’s defense, leaving his neighbors’ lands vulnerable to attack.
divinity_generator: Gain [30] Divinity when hit by an enemy.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +25%, Armor Multiplier +15%, Weapon Multiplier +15%

skills.name: Noble Martyr
skills.description: Transfers 20% of the damage inflicted on allies to this hero.
skills.awakening_bonus: Heals this hero for 100% of the damage transferred from allies.

skills.name: Regal Bulwark
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (180%DEF+110%ATK) then place [mechanic:def-up-ii] on this hero for 1 turn.

skills.name: Guardian Giant
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (220%DEF+130%ATK). Place [mechanic:protect-ii] on all allies except this hero for 2 turns.
skills.awakening_bonus: Place [Phoenix] on any ally below 20% HP for 1 turn.

skills.name: Mystical Cauldron
skills.description: Place [mechanic:shield]200%DEF on all allies above 50% HP and 100%DEF all allies below 50% HP then revive 1 dead ally with 40% HP and Turn Meter. Also place [mechanic:intercept] on any ally below 20% HP for 1 turn.

imprint_passive: Transfers 10% of the damage inflicted on allies to this hero.
